caption: The same uncut studio shot continues without a transition. The same adult man continues the slow clockwise turn from the previous moment, passing through side profile until his back nearly faces the camera. His short black left-parted hair, trimmed mustache when visible, small scar above his right eyebrow when visible, dark round glasses, forest green corduroy jacket, white crew-neck shirt, and brass wristwatch remain identical. Smooth continuous motion, no jump cut, soft window light, neutral gray background.
